regions.merged_text: To breathe, to foster, to promote by exercising the princi- ples of appreciation and and gratitude, the simplest, the most natural science; which at the same time is for To breathe in, and to foster by the principles of apprecia- tion and gratitude, the simplest and most natural, yet the very greatest science of all times and of all places; the science of all sciences without which every dream of lasting peace is vain, every thought of true happiness, a castle in the air; every as- sociation of rational creatures and every company is as dead as Johnnie's potatoes without salt; the science for want of angels have bdcome devils and surpassing lights of heavenly intelligence have bdcome reprobate D.Fs. Ah! the Seraphic ... Association to foster and to promote the supreme privilege of helping to save immortal souls - charity properly-ordered, necessarily beginning at home, viz, in the conversion and further conversion of each one's own individual heart; all of which means nothing more and nothing less than fostering: "Religion, the Science of Our Happy Relationship with God and our neighbor: To breathe-in, to foster, to promote by primary principles of appreciation and gratitude the simplest, and most natural, yet at the same time the greatest science of all times and of all places; the science without which every dream of lasting peace is vain, every thought and every sigh for true happiness (is) a bauble" Ah ! the Ser. As'n to harmonize with
